name: medsupp-oh
title: Ohio Medicare supplement rates and refunds
summary: Rate Medicare supplement plans in Ohio and check a refund calculation, from two insurers' filings: rates by plan, age, sex and area, discounts, a rate increase exhibit, the NAIC refund calculation and the filings' own errors.
description: Each task gives the AI the text of one insurer's filed rate page and actuarial memorandum and another insurer's filed refund calculation, and states its facts in the question, such as an applicant's age, county, plan and way of paying. It asks for exact answers: a monthly rate, a discount, a ratio, a line of an exhibit, whether a refund is due, or the errors in the documents themselves. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Rating area
families.what: The rating area of a county, including counties the page does not list and names that look alike.

families.name: Rate lookup
families.what: The monthly rate by plan, attained age, sex and area, on the right form and under headings printed over each other.

families.name: Payment mode and discounts
families.what: Discounts for the way of paying and for two insureds in one home, and who qualifies for them.

families.name: Attained age
families.what: The change in rate at a birthday, and the age at which each table stops rising.

families.name: Implied relativities
families.what: The area and sex ratios the rate table implies, though the filing states none.

families.name: Open and closed plans
families.what: Which forms are open to new applicants, read through a heading printed over another.

families.name: Rate development
families.what: The memorandum's rate increase exhibit line by line, and the indicated increases the insurer did not take.

families.name: Aggregate increase
families.what: Whether the stated overall increase comes out again, weighted by premium or by membership.

families.name: Refund calculation
families.what: The steps of the NAIC refund calculation, through to the credibility tolerance and whether a refund is due.

families.name: Checking the filings
families.what: The filings' own errors, told apart from figures that only look wrong.
